lines.text: Many learners say: It is the first time I come here.
Better: It is the first time I have come here.
After the first time, we say have come.
Has come! It is the first time she has come here.

data.wrong: It is the first time I come here.
data.right: It is the first time I have come here.
data.why: After the first time, we say have come.

quiz.stem: It is the first time she ___ here.
